shots.opening_composition: Wide two-shot from the terrace edge: subject 1 (bearded, dark hair, ember-toned combat leathers, twin ignited flame-blades) crouched low beside a broken column on the left; subject 2 (clean-faced, dark hair, pale frost-trimmed armor, heavy frost greatsword held high) standing center-right in cold air with visible breath.
shots.description: Subject 1 explodes forward in a low sliding dash along the cracked flagstones, trailing sparks, and closes the distance before subject 2 can reset his guard. He feints a high cut that makes subject 2 raise the greatsword, then pivots under the blade and rakes both flame-blades across subject 2's forearms with a sharp crack of heated metal as the frost guard splinters. The impact staggers subject 2 half a step; subject 1 rides the recoil into a spinning double slash that clips subject 2's shoulder and drives him backward, his boots skidding on stone until he slams into the column, the rock chipping with a heavy thud while frost veins spider across its face. Subject 1 presses without pause, hopping onto the column's base and throwing a short fire burst at subject 2's face that forces him to twist away, head snapping aside as embers scatter.
shots.end_state: Subject 2 braced against the broken column on the right, greatsword planted in the ground for balance and off-kilter; subject 1 perched on the column base with both flame-blades extended, holding the offensive initiative.
shots.transition: Subject 2's planted greatsword becomes the pivot of his reversal; the cut lands as frost begins racing from that blade into the flagstones beneath subject 1.

shots.opening_composition: Arcing view wrapping around the column: subject 2 still braced against it on the right, subject 1 advancing from the base on the left, bright frost veins spreading across the stone floor between them.
shots.description: Subject 2 drives the greatsword's pommel into the ground and channels a burst of ice that races outward under subject 1's feet; the flagstones lock with a cracking snap as his footing seizes. Before subject 1 can break free, subject 2 wrenches the blade up in a rising frost arc that meets subject 1's next flame slash head-on, a violent hiss of steam where fire and ice collide and the shockwave knocks subject 1 off the column base. Subject 2 uses the collision's push to rotate his hips and swing the greatsword in a low horizontal sweep that catches subject 1 around the waist, hurling him sideways across the terrace. Subject 1 tumbles over a fallen pillar, rolling to absorb the impact, and pops up on the far side of it as subject 2 strides after him, dragging a ribbon of frost behind the blade; the fight has now crossed from the column line into the open middle of the terrace.
shots.end_state: Subject 1 back on his feet beyond the fallen pillar in the center of the terrace with blades held low; subject 2 advancing with the greatsword trailing ice, initiative now flipped to him.
shots.transition: Subject 2's forward stride opens a heavy overhead strike; the cut lands as the greatsword clears its backswing above subject 1's head.

shots.opening_composition: Side tracking view as subject 2 bears down on subject 1 in the terrace center, greatsword raised high with frost crackling along its edge; broken columns and the low iron balustrade behind them.
shots.description: Subject 2 brings the greatsword down in a crushing overhead chop aimed at subject 1's guard; subject 1 sidesteps at the last instant and the blade bites into the flagstones, shattering a wedge of stone with a deep boom that sends shards flying. The recoil of the embedded sword leaves subject 2 momentarily committed, so subject 1 slips inside the arc and drives a flame-blade thrust at his ribs, but subject 2 catches the point on the flat of his own blade with a ringing clang and uses the contact to shoulder-check subject 1 backward into the low balustrade. The iron rail groans and buckles under the impact as frost climbs up it from subject 2's grip. Subject 1 rebounds off the rail and backflips over the broken section, landing beyond it near the collapsed archway while subject 2 yanks the greatsword free of the shattered stone with a grinding scrape and follows, swinging a wide horizontal frost cleave that slices the air where subject 1 just stood.
shots.end_state: Subject 1 landed past the balustrade near the collapsed archway at the terrace's far end with blades raised to meet the incoming cleave; subject 2 mid-swing with the greatsword extended, momentum carrying him forward.
shots.transition: Subject 1's raised blades and subject 2's extended cleave converge; the cut lands on the moment of contact while the offensive is still fully engaged.

shots.opening_composition: Tighter framing pushing in toward the far end: subject 1 and subject 2 closing over the last stretch of cracked stone before the collapsed archway, both weapons committed to the exchange.
shots.description: The horizontal frost cleave meets subject 1's crossed flame-blades in a blinding flash of steam and ringing metal that throws sparks and ice shards outward; the force drives subject 1's boots skidding backward across the flagstones while subject 2 keeps pressing the blade forward, grinding it along the crossed steel. Subject 1 twists his wrists to deflect the greatsword aside and immediately counters with a rising flame slash at subject 2's throat, forcing him to drop into a low parry that sends a spray of molten sparks up past his face. Without releasing the parry, subject 2 pivots on his back foot and hammers a short upward ice jab under subject 1's guard, the point striking the blade with a sharp crack that snaps a shard of frost off the steel. Subject 1 is driven back to the lip of the collapsed archway; he plants his heels and throws both flame-blades in a wide two-handed overhead arc aimed at subject 2's head, while subject 2 answers by launching a full committed thrust of the greatsword straight down its length, and the final instant catches the two weapons locked mid-collision with steam erupting between them, neither attack resolved.
shots.end_state: Both fighters locked at the archway lip, flame-blades and frost greatsword clashing in an unresolved mid-strike, bodies braced against each other's momentum, the offensive still fully engaged at the cut.
shots.transition: Final shot; the clip ends on this unresolved collision with no further cut.

overall_soundscape: Fully diegetic and synchronized to the action: skidding boots and sliding dashes on stone, the crack of heated metal on frost-guarded arms, a heavy thud as a body slams into a column, the cracking snap of flagstones freezing, a violent hiss of steam where fire meets ice, ringing clangs and grinding scrapes of blade-on-blade, deep booms of shattered stone with flying shards, the groan of buckling iron rail, and bursts of erupting steam on each collision. No human voice, no grunts, no spoken words.
non_diegetic_music: None. There is no music of any kind; the audio bed is entirely diegetic.
